title: Banana Lens project configuration
description: Optional. Banana Lens detects include directories and flags by itself; use this file only for unusual projects.

command.description: Full command template. Placeholders: {file}, {fileBasename}, {workspace}, {project}. Only the flags are used; the file is appended automatically.

extraArgs.description: Extra flags appended to the auto-detected ones.

includePaths.description: Extra include directories, relative to the project root.

autoIncludes.description: Set to false to disable the include-directory auto-discovery.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to the project root) of files that must not be checked, e.g. "tests/**".
